title: One child dead and another in hospital after house fire in Kent
summary: Emergency services say ‘intense fire’ spread throughout semi-detached property in Hamstreet near Ashford A child has died and a second has been taken to hospital after a house fire in Kent, emergency services have said. The blaze occurred in White Admiral Way in the village of Hamstreet, near Ashford, on Sunday. Continue reading...

title: P.E.I. researchers look at how cow poop can strengthen soil, reduce emissions
